inventory.notes: Incomplete inventory: these 63 rows are not a Go coverage denominator. Schema1 status is qualification-only; README distinguishes implementation and acceptance. The direct pointer-receiver implementation is source-only UNRUN. Three unchanged-file triplets remain explicitly prior-snapshot metadata, not qualification of the pointer-method changes; local/nullable pointer rows are missing pending new unit-file requalification. The prior published67e7 integer-range snapshot (identity sha256:4364fba43fd7e5ae6dd433ec683262ea2176ea55fe203a00aad7ce2a934c346c) records791 ordinary/465 integration, but those historical outcomes do not qualify these pointer-method bytes. Its five narrow triplets and historical failures remain in published history, not new execution evidence. The retired pointer-receiver capability code has no remaining emitting site; all five original blocked inputs are preserved as positive obligations. No full Go/stdlib/native pcc1/Mac/runtime/GC acceptance follows.

chapters.title: Conversions to and from a string type

features.title: Scalar and static-string expression switches
features.scope: Optional init and selector; integer/defined-integer/bool/static-string equality; left-to-right case evaluation; selector snapshot; delayed default; independent clause scopes; explicit fallthrough; loop continue versus switch break; syntactic return termination. No type switches, interfaces, aggregate equality, labels or goto. Complete original switches_valid.go is preserved; old invalid switches.go remains a same-source PCC/official negative.

features.title: Value-array range and array len/cap
features.scope: Fixed value arrays only; zero/one/two iteration variables; snapshot when elements are consumed; range expression call evaluation and constant len/cap omission; typed int indices and builtin results; two-phase target assignment; hidden induction index; named scalar element identity; loop/switch break and continue. Pointer arrays, slices, strings/runes, integer/map/channel/function range and closure-observable iteration-variable identities remain outside this runtime-qualified subset.

features.title: Integer range with typed one-time bounds
features.scope: Qualified bounded Linux pcc0/self integer range: zero/one iteration variable, all admitted signed/unsigned and defined integer types, contextual untyped bounds, one-time bound evaluation, per-iteration assignment targets, hidden width-correct induction, zero/negative limits and structured control flow. Addresses of range-declared variables remain explicitly unimplemented; no closure/heap/panic/native-pcc1/Mac/complete-Go claim.

features.title: Negative shift panic
features.scope: Dynamic signed shift counts requiring negative-count panic handling; negative constant shifts remain invalid expressions.

features.title: Remaining non-array/non-integer range
features.scope: String range remains explicitly unsupported. Fixed value-array, integer and bounded pointer-to-array range have separate source implementations; slice/map/channel/function iterator contracts may fail at earlier capability boundaries.

features.title: Package initialization
features.scope: Blank imports, init functions and package initializers requiring runtime execution; static package data remains admitted.

features.title: Direct non-retaining pointer receiver methods
features.scope: Qualified bounded Linux pcc0/self implementation: concrete local defined types and aliases, direct p.M and addressable x.M calls, direct (*T).M expressions, ordinary nullable pointer ABI and closed non-retaining source call graph. T method expressions do not acquire pointer methods; receiver addresses obey existing lexical and per-iteration identity limits. Nil-safe bodies work without caller-derived nonnull; unproven dereference, method values, interfaces, pointer results and escaping storage remain explicit frontiers. No runtime/backend/GC or full Go claim. Acceptance: 23 full-width native observations, complete main, five exact graduated originals and one two-package same-input comparison; 15 normal invalid-source rejections and ten valid-but-unsupported build-only controls remain distinct.

features.title: Predeclared shadowing
features.scope: Rebinding predeclared names by declarations or imported package aliases; invalid undeclared names do not get this code.

features.title: Slice storage
features.scope: Explicitly rejected capability: slice storage. No broader implementation or runtime support is claimed.

features.title: String bounds panic
features.scope: Explicitly rejected capability: string bounds panic. No broader implementation or runtime support is claimed.

features.title: Struct tags
features.scope: Explicitly rejected capability: struct tags. No broader implementation or runtime support is claimed.

features.title: Local pointer escape
features.scope: Escaping local aliases that outlive their lexical pointee region remain unsupported; same-or-inner-region aliases and call-duration parameter provenance are implemented separately. A nil guard does not extend pointee lifetime.

features.title: Escaping pointer results and unchecked call contracts
features.scope: Pointer-valued returns and unchecked/retaining callees remain unsupported. Independently source-guarded direct parameters are implemented only for a verified complete non-retaining supplied-source call closure; no caller-derived nonnull assumptions.

features.title: Pointer-bearing storage
features.scope: Package pointer storage, pointer-bearing aggregates and pointer-to-pointer storage require recursive ownership/lifetime analysis.

features.title: Unproven evaluated pointer indirection
features.scope: Evaluated indirection without a source-control-flow nonnil proof requires an unimplemented shared-runtime nil-panic path. Nullable storage itself is implemented. Unevaluated operands and existing control edges do not invent a dereference obligation or erase one that executes.

features.title: Per-iteration pointer identity
features.scope: Taking addresses of declared for/range iteration bindings requires distinct per-iteration storage; entry-slot reuse is not accepted as Go identity.

features.title: Addressed composite literal allocation
features.scope: Addressed composite literals require distinct allocation/lifetime analysis rather than reusing a value temporary.

features.title: Conversions across pointer base types
features.scope: Conversions between pointers to distinct base types with identical underlying types are recognized but not implemented.

features.title: Pointer expression switches
features.scope: Comparable pointer expression-switch selectors are not implemented.

features.title: Nonescaping local pointers and value updates
features.scope: Implementation: bounded local aliases, address/deref, pointer equality and indirect scalar/record/array value updates with independent lexical nonescape checks. Acceptance: qualified only for the listed original deterministic source/tests in host pcc0/self/Linux x86_64 with pinned official Go 1.27.3; not general heap pointers. The retained original ordinary-receiver ordering observer is diagnostic only and excluded from acceptance.

features.title: Nullable locals and source-guarded non-retaining direct pointer parameters
features.scope: Implementation: nullable locals and independently source-guarded non-retaining direct pointer parameters; finite CFG nullability and lexical/call-duration lifetime proofs, short-circuit/joins/backedges/continue/post/break/switch-fallthrough and pre-store parallel-assignment checks. Complete supplied source call closure is checked without noalias/caller-derived nonnull or new runtime/backend machinery. Acceptance: listed unit/native/same-input raw-pair cases qualified in host pcc0/self/Linux x86_64 with Go 1.27.3; 30 full-width observations, six exact graduated originals and an unchanged two-package pair pass the complete Go selections. Pointer-valued returns, escaping/pointer-bearing storage and unproven evaluated indirection remain unsupported.

features.title: Live pointer-to-fixed-array range
features.scope: Qualified bounded Linux pcc0/self implementation: admitted *[N]E and defined/alias types, constant-length index-only non-evaluation, nullable zero-length iteration, source-guarded nonempty element access, once-captured pointer with live element loads and ordinary iteration assignments. Function-produced pointers, unproven nil dereference, escaping storage and addresses of declared iteration variables retain their existing capability boundaries. No slice allocation/shared-runtime/backend/GC or complete Go claim. Acceptance: 19 full-width native observations, complete main and two exact graduated originals with three raw same-input pairs; nine invalid-source rejections and nine valid-but-unsupported build-only controls are distinct obligations.

diagnostics.notes: Stable codes are selected explicitly at capability call sites and checked against the Go registry; messages never classify errors. The previous 52 heuristic message candidates were not 52 distinct valid-language capabilities: malformed syntax, forbidden operators, init type names and non-iterable values are not relabeled unsupported. Remaining generic syntax/internal diagnostics are listed conservatively; complete diagnostic/feature coverage is not claimed. Uncoded legacy diagnostics remain kind=unclassified; absence of a capability code is not a validity-error classification.
